title: Apple Music authorization completes on any network where Apple Music works
acceptance: On a network where the Apple Music app itself plays (D25), iPhone Safari's Apple Music authorization in Ritmo returns to Ritmo after Face ID and the preflight shows authorized.
Root cause recorded: which request or redirect stalls on the failing network (Web Inspector on the main page and on the Apple authorization page), or proof that a Ritmo header/flow causes it.
If authorization cannot complete, Ritmo stops waiting within a bounded time and tells the instructor what happened and what to try, instead of a stuck Apple screen.
nextAction: Owner: retry authorization on cellular to confirm it completes there, then on home Wi-Fi with Web Inspector attached to the Apple authorization page (Develop menu lists it separately). Do not change product code from this task without approval; any fix is owner-gated (playback/auth surfaces).

evidence.summary: Owner, 2026-10-28, iPhone Safari on home Wi-Fi after the RF-122 deploy: the Apple authorization screen opens and Face ID succeeds, then the screen stays stuck; a refresh shows the Apple Music sign-in again. Earlier the same evening on cellular (5G) authorization completed every time. Not yet diagnosed; Ritmo sends no Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header.
